scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，請先整理物品欄再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text: Relics for Archbishops are meant for defense and support!
scripts.translation: 主教的遺物是為了防禦和支援而存在的！

scripts.text: Like the other Guardians, they may trade coins for their relics, so collect Mora Coins!
scripts.translation: 和其他守護者一樣，我們也接受用硬幣兌換遺物，去收集穆拉村硬幣吧！

scripts.text: If you collect more than 10 coins then come to me to trade!
scripts.translation: 如果你收集了10枚以上的硬幣，就來找我交換吧！

scripts.text: By the light! You look like you are ready to gain access to our relics.
scripts.translation: 光明作證！看來你已經準備好獲得我們遺物的使用權了。

scripts.text: Ring, Shoes, Shawl, Robe, Shield, or Weapon.
scripts.translation: 戒指、長靴、披肩、長袍、盾牌或武器。

scripts.text: Select one of the six kinds of relics to receive.
scripts.translation: 請選擇六種遺物中的一種來領取。

scripts.text: I'll randomly give you one of 2 types of the equipment, depending upon the weather and my mood.
scripts.translation: 每種有兩款裝備，我會看天氣和心情，隨機給你其中一款。

scripts.text: All I need is 10 Mora Coins of yours to grant you a relic!
scripts.translation: 我只需要你的10枚穆拉村硬幣，就能賜予你一件遺物！

scripts.text: I'm ready to exchange my Mora Coins.
What kind of relic do you want?
You are already allowed access to our relics by your possession of a Ring!
scripts.translation: 你擁有戒指，已經獲得了我們遺物的使用權！

scripts.text: We prefer to only deal with Arch-Bishops.
scripts.translation: 我們只與主教進行交易。

scripts.text: You have obtained ^aa00aa{0}^000000. May the Blessing of the Light be with you.
scripts.translation: 你獲得了^aa00aa{0}^000000。願光明的祝福與你同在。

scripts.text: We exchange rings into coins for those who cannot control the ring.
scripts.translation: 對於無法控制戒指的人，我們可以將戒指兌換成硬幣。

scripts.text: It seems that you have power to control the ring so I cannot exchange it into coins.
scripts.translation: 看來你擁有控制戒指的力量，所以我無法將其兌換成硬幣。
你是不是換了什麼東西？

scripts.text: You have a {0}. Do you really want to trade it for 10 Mora Coins?
scripts.translation: 你有一個{0}。你確定要將其兌換成10枚穆拉村硬幣嗎？

scripts.text: If you change your mind, please stop by again.
scripts.translation: 如果你改變主意了，請隨時再來。

scripts.text: I think that was an even trade.
scripts.translation: 我覺得這是一筆公平的交易。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，請先整理物品欄再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text: I enhance Relics that holy Arch-Bishops use, it will take 2 Mora Coins and the relic to allow me to attempt to enhance it.
scripts.translation: 我可以強化大主教使用的聖物。需要2枚穆拉村硬幣和聖物，之後我會嘗試強化。

scripts.text: Let me briefly explain, for 2 Mora Coins and the relic I can give you a single Enchantment on that relic.
scripts.translation: 簡單來說，帶上遺物，支付2枚穆拉村硬幣，就能附魔一次。

scripts.text: Even though this relic was already enchanted, we will re-enchant it without checking its status.
scripts.translation: 無論遺物之前有沒有附魔，我都會直接重新附魔，不會先檢查。

scripts.text: So it you have already enchanted relic, please put it some place safe and come back.
scripts.translation: 所以，已經附魔好的遺物，請先放到安全的地方，再來找我。

scripts.text: Ah, one more thing! It is possible I can fail though and if that happens the relic is lost forever.
scripts.translation: 啊，還有一件事！強化可能會失敗，如果失敗了，遺物將永遠丟失。

scripts.text: Ok, you can get a new Relic from Artifice if it fails.
scripts.translation: 好吧，如果失敗了，你可以找阿蒂菲斯獲得新的遺物。

scripts.text: If you have a ritual for luck, you should use it now!
scripts.translation: 有什麼求好運的儀式，現在就趕緊做吧！

scripts.text: For 2 Mora Coins I can strengthen the relic you have in many ways!
scripts.translation: 只需2枚穆拉村硬幣，我就能以多種方式強化你手中的遺物！

scripts.text: Sometimes things just don't work out the way you want. I hope next time things go better for you. Until then, good bye.
scripts.translation: 事情有時不會如你所願。希望下次能順利些。那就再見了。

scripts.text: Sometimes things just don't work out the way you want. I hope next time things go better for you. Until then, good bye.
scripts.translation: 事情有時不會如你所願。希望下次能順利些。那就再見了。

scripts.text: Sometimes things just don't work out the way you want. I hope next time things go better for you. Until then, good bye.
scripts.translation: 事情有時不會如你所願。希望下次能順利些。那就再見了。

scripts.text: Sometimes things just don't work out the way you want. I hope next time things go better for you. Until then, good bye.
scripts.translation: 事情有時不會如你所願。希望下次能順利些。那就再見了。

scripts.text: The strengthening went well, lucky you!
You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，請先整理物品欄再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text: My job is to guard the Warlock's ancient artifacts.
scripts.translation: 我的職責是守護大魔導士的古代神器。

scripts.text: Well, it's not a big deal actually. I give out artifacts to those who deserve them for the price of a few Mora Coins.
scripts.translation: 其實也沒什麼大不了的。只要支付幾枚穆拉村硬幣，我就會把神器交給那些值得擁有它們的人。

scripts.text: You can trade with me when you have 10 or more Coins. See you later.
scripts.translation: 當你擁有10枚或更多硬幣時，就可以來找我交易了。回頭見。

scripts.text: Wow~ I see you're ready for the Warlock's Ancient Artifacts.
scripts.translation: 哇~看來你已經準備好獲取大魔導士的古代神器了。

scripts.text: You can choose from four types of items:
scripts.translation: 你可以從四種類型的物品中選擇：

scripts.text: There are four options available for each type, but the item available will change day to day, depending on my mood.
scripts.translation: 每個類別有四款裝備，今天能換到哪款，要看我的心情，每天都不一樣。

scripts.text: Do you want to buy an artifact with your Mora Coins?
scripts.translation: 您想用穆拉村硬幣購買神器嗎？

scripts.text: Maybe later... I have things to do.
scripts.translation: 也許以後吧...我有事要做

scripts.text: What type of item do you want to buy?
scripts.translation: 您想購買哪種型別的物品？

scripts.text: Would you please come back when you have enough Coins?
scripts.translation: 請您在擁有足夠硬幣時再來好嗎？

scripts.text: I have ^aa00aa{0}^000000 available today. I hope {1} will come in handy...
scripts.translation: 今天我有^aa00aa{0}^000000。希望{1}能派上用場...

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，請先整理物品欄再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text: My job is to imbue artifacts with new power. If you have enough Coins, you can have one of the following items reinforced.
scripts.translation: 我的工作是賦予神器新的力量。如果您有足夠的硬幣，可以強化以下物品之一。

scripts.text: I want to have my item reinforced.
Let me explain. One reinforcement costs you two Coins.
scripts.translation: 讓我解釋一下。一次強化需要消耗兩枚硬幣。

scripts.text: And, I'll work on the item whether it's been already reinforced or not.
scripts.translation: 不管裝備以前有沒有強化過，我都會直接加工。

scripts.text: So if you have an artifact reinforced to your liking, put it in a safe place and come back.
scripts.translation: 所以，已經強化到滿意狀態的神器，請先收好，再來找我。

scripts.text: And another thing, the artifact will be destroyed if the reinforcement fails. Please keep that in mind.
scripts.translation: 還有一點，如果強化失敗，神器將會被破壞。請牢記這一點。

scripts.text: You have to have 2 Mora Coins and an item to be reinforced before I can do my work.
scripts.translation: 您需要持有2枚穆拉村硬幣和一件待強化的物品，我才能開始工作。

scripts.text: Oh no... it broke... Well, it happens. Better luck next time.
scripts.translation: 糟糕...它壞了...唉，這種事時有發生。下次再試試吧。

scripts.text: Oh no... it broke... Well, it happens. Better luck next time.
scripts.translation: 糟糕...它壞了...唉，這種事時有發生。下次再試試吧。

scripts.text: Looks like my effort was successful.
Reduce the amount of items that you have in your inventory before continuing.
scripts.translation: 在繼續之前，請先減少背包中的物品數量。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much in your inventory.
I give Rune Knights, Guillotine Crosses, and Rangers ancient artifacts to help them carry out their missions.
scripts.translation: 我提供古代神器給盧恩騎士、十字斬首者和遊俠，以幫助他們執行任務。

scripts.text: There are guardians that give Mora Village coins which you can use to exchange for these artifacts.
scripts.translation: 有一些守護者會發放穆拉村硬幣，您可以使用這些硬幣來兌換這些神器。

scripts.text: If you collect 10 or more Mora coins, then I can trade them for the artifacts.
scripts.translation: 如果您收集到10枚或更多的穆拉村硬幣，我就可以將它們兌換為神器。

scripts.text: I think that you're ready to receive the ancient artifacts.
scripts.translation: 我想你已經準備好接收古代神器了。

scripts.text: Based on what class you specify, there are various artifacts available.
scripts.translation: 根據你指定的職業，有不同的神器可供選擇。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Choose carefully because these artifacts aren't easy to come by^000000. So what class do you want it for?
scripts.translation: ^ff0000請慎重選擇，這些神器並不容易獲得^000000。你想為哪個職業強化？

scripts.text: Didn't I tell you to bring the correct amount of Mora Coins?
scripts.translation: 我不是告訴過你要帶正確數量的穆拉村硬幣嗎？

scripts.text: Thank you for the 10 Mora Coins. Here is your artifact for the {0} job. Come back whenever you get more Mora Coins.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你支付的10枚穆拉村硬幣。這是適用於{0}職業的神器。以後攢夠穆拉村硬幣再來吧。

scripts.text: Reduce the amount of items that you have in your inventory before continuing.
scripts.translation: 在繼續之前，請先減少背包中的物品數量。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much in your inventory.

scripts.translation: 很高興見到你，我在穆拉研究古代遺物和神器。

scripts.text: I'm here in Mora studying ancient relics and artifacts. The new discoveries of Adventurers has made this village very exciting for me.
scripts.translation: 冒險者們帶來的新發現，讓我覺得這座村子越來越有意思了。

scripts.text: New artifacts have been found here in Mora village, haven't you heard the news?
scripts.translation: 聽說穆拉村發現了新的神器，你聽到了嗎？

scripts.text: If you come across any of these artifacts, there are hidden powers that can be extracted from them.
scripts.translation: 如果你遇到這些神器，可以從中提取隱藏的力量。

scripts.text: I'm going to continue my research for these artifacts. We researchers are taking Mora Coins as payment for our services...
scripts.translation: 我將繼續研究這些神器。我們研究員收取穆拉村硬幣作為服務費用...

scripts.text: I'm offering my services to give abilities to the artifacts for 100,000 zeny and 1 Mora Coin.
scripts.translation: 我提供賦予神器能力的服務，費用是100,000 Zeny和1枚穆拉村硬幣。

scripts.text: The best part of my service is that any enhancements that you have in these artifacts will not be harmed.
scripts.translation: 我服務最大的好處是，神器上已有的強化效果不會受到損害。

scripts.text: I'm not giving these services out for free pal. 100,000 zeny and 1 Mora Coin. Is that too much to ask?
scripts.translation: 我可不會免費提供這些服務，朋友。100,000 Zeny和1枚穆拉村硬幣。這要求過分嗎？

scripts.text: Ok, so are you ready? Before I start working on this, what kind of equipment did you want me to enhance?
scripts.translation: 好，準備好了嗎？在我開始之前，你想強化哪件裝備？

scripts.text: Make sure you're wearing the equipment first.
scripts.translation: 請確保你先穿戴好該裝備。

scripts.text: Make sure you're wearing the equipment first.
scripts.translation: 請確保你先穿戴好該裝備。

scripts.text: I really want to study this equipment...
scripts.translation: 我真的好想研究一下這件裝備...

scripts.text: It's a considerable reinforcement to the equipment. In this case extended enhancements can be granted. Which stat do you want to enhance?
scripts.translation: 這會大幅強化裝備。在這種情況下可以進行額外強化。你想強化哪項屬性？

scripts.text: Attempting to strengthen the ability further. The previous enforcement won't be affected. Do you want to continue?
scripts.translation: 嘗試進一步強化屬性。之前的強化不會受到影響。要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Attempting second enhancement. The previous enforcement won't be affected.
scripts.translation: 正在嘗試第二次強化。之前的強化效果不會受到影響。

scripts.text: I may have a chance to fail now with this attempt. Do you wish to continue?
scripts.translation: 這次嘗試我可能會失敗。您確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Let's start the third enhancement. I can give the best stats at this stage but remember, ^990000there is now a chance for the artifact to be destroyed and previous enhancements will be erased^000000. Continue?
scripts.translation: 我們開始第三次強化吧。此階段可以賦予最佳屬性，但請注意，^990000神器有一定機率損毀，之前的強化也會全部消失^000000。要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: This artifact has been strengthened to the limit. Further enhancement is impossible at its current state.
scripts.translation: 這件神器已經強化到了極限。以目前的狀態，無法再進行強化。

scripts.text: If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation: 如果您改變主意，請隨時回來。

scripts.text: Well I guess I was wrong...
I think there was an enhancing limit to the artifacts.
scripts.translation: 我想神器是有強化上限的。

scripts.text: I'm not going to do the work unless you pay the fee.
scripts.translation: 除非您支付費用，否則我不會做這項工作。

scripts.text: I... I'm sorry but the equipment has been destroyed.
Since the balance of power does not match, the given existing ability has been destroyed. It is unfortunate but please try again next time.
scripts.translation: 由於力量失衡，原有的屬效能力被破壞了。很遺憾，請下次再試。

scripts.text: I've successfully enhanced the artifact ^990000{0}^000000 at socket {1}.
You've got to pay if you want the services.
scripts.translation: 如果您想要服務，就必須付費。

scripts.text: Reduce the amount of items that you have in your inventory before continuing.
scripts.translation: 在繼續之前，請先減少背包中的物品數量。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much in your inventory.
Those Mora Artifacts look so perfect!
scripts.translation: 那些穆拉神器看起來太完美了！

scripts.text: But I know you want them to be even better!
scripts.translation: 但我知道你想讓它們變得更好！

scripts.text: Greetings Adventurer. We will be great friends in a moment after I tell you how to Empower your Artifacts!
scripts.translation: 你好，冒險者。等我告訴你如何強化神器，我們馬上就會成為好朋友！

scripts.text: You seem like a pretty good judge of character.
For over 200 years I've been working with Artifacts here in Mora. Toiling to get the perfect +9!
scripts.translation: 我在穆拉鑽研神器已超過200年，一直為打造完美的+9神器而努力！

scripts.text: My business is collecting the old relics and refining them to their essence!
scripts.translation: 我的工作是收集古老的遺物，並提煉出它們的精華！

scripts.text: Finding the perfect Artifact for me to experiment on is my life's work.
scripts.translation: 尋找完美的神器供我實驗，是我畢生的事業。

scripts.text: Plus seeing the wonder of our ancestor's legacy is also gratifying.
scripts.translation: 此外，見證祖先留下的奇蹟遺產，也是一件令人欣慰的事。

scripts.text: I can see how that could be fun.
I've been doing this for over 200 years, and honestly the readily available supply is gone, and Artificer and Artifact Crafter won't trade me anymore...
scripts.translation: 我從事這項工作已經超過200年了，說實話，現成的材料已經用完了，而且工匠和神器工匠也不願意再和我交易了...

scripts.text: But maybe the Humans that are starting to visit can bring in some new stock!
scripts.translation: 不過，也許最近開始來訪的人類能帶來一些新的庫存！

scripts.text: Yes! If the humans can bring me new artifacts I can work on my ultimate achievement!
scripts.translation: 沒錯！如果人類能給我帶來新的神器，我就能完成我的終極成就！
耐心點，我們馬上就會談到那個...

scripts.text: I am a collector, by trade, but my greatest achievement is empowering some artifacts with greater power!
scripts.translation: 我本職是收藏家，但最自豪的，是能為一些神器賦予更強的力量！

scripts.text: I have only perfected my ability on a few Artifact types so far.
scripts.translation: 目前只有少數幾類，我已經完全掌握了手法。

scripts.text: You might just be the human to help me complete my plan.
scripts.translation: 你也許就是那個能幫我完成計劃的人類。

scripts.text: Oh how I love how fate works sometimes...
+1, +2, +3, +4, +5, +6 those refinements are not strong enough to work on my craft.
scripts.translation: +1、+2、+3、+4、+5、+6，這些精煉等級都不夠，施展不了我的手藝。

scripts.text: But +7! +7 is rare and just barely strong enough to work in my crafting attempts.
scripts.translation: 但+7！+7就不同了，雖然稀有，也才剛夠讓我嘗試製作。

scripts.text: Right you are! I know it is natural for you Humans to help a friend, even without the friend asking...
scripts.translation: 你說得對！我知道你們人類天生樂於幫助朋友，即使朋友沒有開口請求...

scripts.text: Of course I'll accept your help!  Find me...
scripts.translation: 我當然會接受你的幫助！請幫我尋找...

scripts.text: Well aside from the +7, there are very specific enchantments that need to be on the artifact that help catalyze the process.
scripts.translation: 除了精煉到+7，還要有特定的附魔，才能催化整個過程。

scripts.text: If either the +7 or the specific enchantment is missing I can't do it.
scripts.translation: 精煉不到+7，或沒有指定附魔，都做不了。

scripts.text: So the Refining will be preserved?
scripts.translation: 那麼精煉等級會被保留嗎？

scripts.text: No, but what you'll get back is so much better!
scripts.translation: 不會保留，但你會得到更好的東西！

scripts.text: By now you are wondering more about the artifacts I'm looking for?
scripts.translation: 現在，你是不是更想了解我正在尋找的神器了？

scripts.text: Ok, well maybe someday you will be.
scripts.translation: 好吧，也許有一天你會感興趣的。

scripts.text: {0} must of course be refined to +7 or higher for me to distill it to an enchantment.
scripts.translation: {0}必須精煉到+7或以上，我才能將它提煉、賦予更強的力量。

scripts.text: It must also carry any of these enchantments: {0} to be craftable by me.
scripts.translation: 它還必須帶有以下任一附魔：{0}，這樣我才能進行製作。

scripts.text: But please if you do get one, please let me work on it, I'm begging you.
scripts.translation: 但是如果你找到了，請讓我來處理它，我求求你了。

scripts.text: Have yourself a great day. Bye~
Let me take a look at what you have brought me.
scripts.translation: 讓我看看你帶來了什麼。

scripts.text: I don't know what you are trying to do... I can't enhance what you don't have.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你想做什麼...我無法強化你沒有的東西。

scripts.text: The weapon you have isn't one of the Artifacts I can work with.
scripts.translation: 你手中的武器並不是我能處理的神器。

scripts.text: I must insist that the refine level of the Artifact be at least +7!
scripts.translation: 我必須堅持，神器的精煉等級至少要是+7！

scripts.text: These attributes just won't do for my research process, try re-randoming them.
scripts.translation: 這些屬性不符合研究要求，試著重新隨機附魔吧。

scripts.text: You've brought me everything I need!!
scripts.translation: 你帶來了我所需要的一切！！

scripts.text: If you are ready I am about to show you what I can do with your +{0} Artifact!
scripts.translation: 準備好了，就讓我拿這件+{0}神器展示一下手藝！

scripts.text: I'm going to take your ^FF0000{0}^000000 and exchange it, are you ready?
scripts.translation: 我要收走你的^FF0000{0}^000000，用它來兌換，準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: You've got to be kidding... you got my hopes up...
scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑吧...你讓我滿懷期待...

scripts.text: Surely you want to go on?
You've got to be kidding... you got my hopes up...
scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑吧...你讓我滿懷期待...

scripts.text: It is perfectly done, you will be so happy! Good bye friend~
scripts.translation: 完美完成了，你會很開心的！再見，朋友~

scripts.text: If worn with Robes, Shoes, and Robe of Mercy Increase Heal Bonus by an additional 45% and SP consumption of 'Heal' by 50.
scripts.translation: 與長袍、鞋子和慈悲之袍一起裝備時，治癒加成額外增加45%，治癒術的SP消耗增加50。

scripts.text: When receives close physical attack, Lv.1 Silentium will be excuted at a certain rate.
scripts.translation: 受到近距離物理攻擊時，有一定機率發動1級靜寂。

scripts.text: Recuces 3 seconds of delay after excuting Clearance, Laudaramus, and Laudaagnus skills.
scripts.translation: 解除、謳歌讚頌和謳歌天使施放後的延遲縮短3秒。

scripts.text: Physical and Magical Attacks have a chance to increase damage by 40% to Demon monsters for 7 seconds.
scripts.translation: 物理和魔法攻擊時有一定機率在7秒內對惡魔系魔物造成的傷害增加40%。

scripts.text: If worn with Judgement Golves, Shoes and Shawl, increase Damage against Undead by 30%.
scripts.translation: 與審判手套、鞋子和披肩一起裝備時，對不死系的傷害增加30%。

scripts.text: Increase damage of Adoramus by 200%, and increase SP cost of Adoramus by 30.
scripts.translation: 謳歌的傷害增加200%，SP消耗增加30。

scripts.text: If worn with Golden Robe, Golden Shoes, and Golden Orb Increase Wind Magic damage by 60%.
scripts.translation: 與黃金長袍、黃金鞋和黃金寶珠一起裝備時，風屬性魔法傷害增加60%。

scripts.text: Lower Earth Magic damage by 60% and resistance to Earth by 50%.
scripts.translation: 地屬性魔法傷害降低60%，地屬性抗性降低50%。

scripts.text: Increase Cold Bolt and Frost Diver damage by 30%.
scripts.translation: 冰箭術和冰凍術傷害增加30%。

scripts.text: If worn with Aqua Robe, Shoes, and Orb Increase Water Magic damage by 60%.
scripts.translation: 與海洋長袍、鞋子和寶珠一起裝備時，水屬性魔法傷害增加60%。

scripts.text: Lower Wind Magic damage by 60% and resistance to Wind by 50%.
scripts.translation: 風屬性魔法傷害降低60%，風屬性抗性降低50%。

scripts.text: Increase Fire Bolt and Fireball damage by 30%.
scripts.translation: 火箭術和火球術傷害增加30%。

scripts.text: If worn with Crimson Robe, Shoes, and Orb Increase Fire Magic damage by 60%.
scripts.translation: 與緋紅長袍、鞋子和寶珠一起裝備時，火屬性魔法傷害增加60%。

scripts.text: Lower Water Magic damage by 60% and resistance to Water by 50%.
scripts.translation: 水屬性魔法傷害降低60%，水屬性抗性降低50%。

scripts.text: Increase Earth Spike and Heaven's Drive damage by 30%.
scripts.translation: 地震術和崩裂術傷害增加30%。

scripts.text: If worn with Forest Robe, Shoes, and Orb Increase Earth Magic damage by 60%.
scripts.translation: 與森林長袍、鞋子和寶珠一起裝備時，地屬性魔法傷害增加60%。

scripts.text: Lower Fire Magic damage by 60% and resistance to Fire by 50%.
scripts.translation: 火屬性魔法傷害降低60%，火屬性抗性降低50%。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，請先整理物品欄再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text: With my touch, I can turn a typical army padding into a piece of art. I'm Kay the Master Tailor, creating art with army paddings.
scripts.translation: 憑藉我的手藝，我能將普通的軍用內衣變成藝術品。我是裁縫大師凱，用軍用內衣創造藝術。

scripts.text: Well, what's in a name? I can turn your army padding into a piece of art if you bring ^ff00005 Mora Coins and an Army Padding^000000.
scripts.translation: 名字什麼的無所謂。只要你帶著^ff00005枚穆拉村硬幣和一件軍用內衣^000000，我就能把它變成藝術品。

scripts.text: I happen to have a few army paddings in stock. Would you like to buy one? The price is 1 Mora Coin. So cheap.
scripts.translation: 我正好有幾件軍用內衣存貨。你想買一件嗎？只要1枚穆拉村硬幣。很便宜吧。

scripts.text: Come back for one if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text: It's very nice and fluffy. Please come back.
scripts.translation: 非常柔軟蓬鬆。請下次再來。

scripts.text: Have you come to add art to one of your army paddings?
scripts.translation: 你是來給你的軍用內衣增添藝術感的嗎？

scripts.text: A typical army padding isn't warm enough. It feels rough on your skin and doesn't look good. And artistic value? It has next to none.
scripts.translation: 普通的軍用內衣不夠保暖。穿在身上粗糙，外觀也不好看。至於藝術價值？幾乎為零。

scripts.text: However, I'll embroider it with velvet threads, and add three options to it.
scripts.translation: 不過，經過我的天鵝絨線刺繡，就能多出三項附加屬性。

scripts.text: Bring me ^8888005 Mora Coins^000000 and an Army Padding, and we can add some art together!
scripts.translation: 帶著^8888005枚穆拉村硬幣^000000和一件軍用內衣來找我，我們一起創造藝術吧！

scripts.text: I'm telling you just in case - I'll do whatever I need to do with your army padding, whether it's brand-new or has been mended before.
scripts.translation: 先說好，不管軍用內衣是全新的，還是已經加工過，我都會直接動手。

scripts.text: So if you have with you an army padding mended to your liking, put it in a safe place and come back.
scripts.translation: 所以，已經加工得很滿意的軍用內衣，請先收好，再來找我。

scripts.text: And another thing - once I fail to add art to it, it becomes unusable... you'll need to buy a new one in that case.
scripts.translation: 還有一件事——如果我新增藝術效果失敗，它就會變得無法使用...到時候你需要買一件新的。

scripts.text: The villagers keep me busy enough.
scripts.translation: 村民們已經讓我忙得不可開交了。

scripts.text: It looks like you don't have everything you need.
scripts.translation: 看起來你缺少必要的材料。

scripts.text: You have to have 5 Mora Coins and an Army Padding with you before I can do my work.
scripts.translation: 在我開始工作之前，你必須攜帶5枚穆拉村硬幣和一件軍用內衣。

scripts.text: I can't believe I messed up.
I want to be alone. Go away!
scripts.translation: 我想一個人靜一靜。請離開！

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，請先整理物品欄再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text: My job is to polish the stone in a Guardian's Pendant, and then carve a symbol with special power on it.
scripts.translation: 我的工作是為守護者吊墜打磨石頭，並在上面雕刻出擁有特殊力量的符文。

scripts.text: The process gives the Guardian's Pendant more power than an ordinary accessory.
scripts.translation: 這個過程會讓守護者吊墜比普通的飾品擁有更強的力量。

scripts.text: If you're interested, I can work on your pendant for ^ff00005 Mora Coins^000000. Of course you need to have a Guardian's Pendant so I can work on with you.
scripts.translation: 如果您感興趣，我可以為您加工守護者吊墜，費用是^ff00005枚穆拉村硬幣^000000。當然，您需要攜帶一個守護者吊墜，我才能為您加工。

scripts.text: Have you come to have your Guardian's Pendant upgraded?
scripts.translation: 您是來升級守護者吊墜的嗎？

scripts.text: My job is to polish the stone in a Guardian's Pendant, and then carve a symbol with special power on it.
scripts.translation: 我的工作是為守護者吊墜打磨石頭，並在上面雕刻出擁有特殊力量的符文。

scripts.text: The process gives the Guardian's Pendant more power than an ordinary accessory.
scripts.translation: 這個過程會讓守護者吊墜比普通的飾品擁有更強的力量。

scripts.text: If you're interested, I can work on your pendant for ^ff00005 Mora Coins^000000. Of course you need to have a Guardian's Pendant so I can work on with you.
scripts.translation: 如果您感興趣，我可以為您加工守護者吊墜，費用是^ff00005枚穆拉村硬幣^000000。當然，您需要攜帶一個守護者吊墜，我才能為您加工。

scripts.text: I'm telling you just in case -
If I work on a Guardian's Pendant that's been upgraded before, it loses its original power.
scripts.translation: 如果我強化已經升級過的守護者吊墜，它原本的力量就會消失。

scripts.text: And worse, it can lose its power and become an ordinary pendant. Of course, stone is not as susceptible to damage as cloth, so you won't lose the pendant itself.
scripts.translation: 更糟糕的是，它可能會失去力量，變成普通的吊墜。當然，石頭不像布料那樣容易損壞，所以您不會失去吊墜本身。

scripts.text: Come back when you're not in a hurry. I always have a lot of time on my hands.
scripts.translation: 有空再來吧，我這裡時間多得很。

scripts.text: It looks like you don't have everything you need.
scripts.translation: 看起來您缺少必要的材料。

scripts.text: You must have 5 Mora Coins and a Guardian's Pendant with you before I can do my work.
scripts.translation: 在我開始工作之前，您必須攜帶5枚穆拉村硬幣和一個守護者吊墜。

scripts.text: What on earth is wrong with it!!
You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品種類太多，請先整理物品欄再試。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much weight to do that. Reduce the weight and try again.
scripts.translation: 負重過高，無法繼續操作，請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text: I'm Bulberry Westhood, keeping the tradition of quality hoods alive.
scripts.translation: 我是布林貝里·韋斯特胡德，致力於傳承優質兜帽的傳統。

scripts.text: I only handle quality items - not random scarfs from a marketplace.
scripts.translation: 我只處理優質物品——而不是市場上隨便買的圍巾。

scripts.text: If you have anything that you think is of high enough quality, come find me with ^ff00005 Mora Coins^000000.
scripts.translation: 如果您有認為足夠優質的物品，請帶著^ff00005枚穆拉村硬幣^000000來找我。

scripts.text: I can improve its high quality with my own hands.
scripts.translation: 經過我的手，還能讓它的品質更上一層樓。

scripts.text: So you have a Loki's Scarf 1042 Special Edition. You really have an eye for quality. Can I start working on it right away?
scripts.translation: 原來您有一條洛基圍巾 1042 特別版。您的眼光真不錯。我可以馬上開始工作嗎？

scripts.text: Like I said, I only handle quality items - not random scarfs from a marketplace.
scripts.translation: 正如我所說的，我只處理優質物品——而不是市場上隨便買的圍巾。

scripts.text: This Loki's Scarf you have is awesome. It's a limited edition product with Loki's crest on it!
scripts.translation: 您這條洛基圍巾真是了不起。這是帶有洛基紋章的限量版產品！

scripts.text: My specialty is bringing out the hidden power at the small cost of...
scripts.translation: 我的專長是隻需付出一點點代價，就能喚醒隱藏力量...

scripts.text: Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 如果您改變主意了，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text: I'm telling you just in case -
If I work on a Loki's Scarf that's been upgraded before, it loses its original power.
scripts.translation: 如果我強化已經升級過的洛基圍巾，它原本的力量就會消失。

scripts.text: And worse, it can lose all its power becoming an ordinary scarf.
scripts.translation: 更糟糕的是，它可能會失去所有力量，變成一條普通的圍巾。

scripts.text: Of course, the Loki's Scarf is a quality item, so you won't lose the scarf itself in the process.
scripts.translation: 當然，洛基圍巾是優質物品，所以在過程中您不會失去圍巾本身。

scripts.text: I'd like to own a quality item!
scripts.translation: 我想擁有一件優質物品！

scripts.text: You say 'later' when you can have the best quality item right away? Well, have it your own way.
scripts.translation: 明明現在就能擁有最高品質的物品，您卻說“以後”？好吧，隨您便。

scripts.text: It looks like you don't everything you need.
scripts.translation: 看來您還沒有準備好所需的一切。

scripts.text: You must have 5 Mora Coins and a Loki's Scarf with you before you can have the best quality item.
scripts.translation: 您需要持有5枚穆拉村硬幣和一條洛基圍巾，才能獲得最高品質的物品。

scripts.text: Oh, I apologize for my disgraceful behavior. I was too upset.
scripts.translation: 噢，我為我失態的行為道歉。我太激動了。

scripts.text: Fortunately, it's still in its original state before I started working on it. It's not torn or stretched. It's a quality item after all. Oh ho ho~
scripts.translation: 幸好它還保持著我動手前的原樣，沒有破損或拉長。畢竟是件上等貨。呵呵呵~
